reporting_guidelines.content: Analyst Relations Reporting Guidelines v3.2: (1) Exec briefs must list firm, analyst, date, report title, rating, and verbatim note. (2) Ratings and quotes must be preserved exactly as sourced; no rounding or paraphrasing. (3) Group by firm tier (tier-1 first). (4) Mark new coverage initiations with a [NEW] tag. (5) All exec briefs require AR lead sign-off before distribution.

exec_brief_format.content: Standard exec-brief format: Header (period, prepared-by, date). Section A: Tier-1 firm highlights. Section B: Tier-2/3 firm highlights. Section C: Net rating movement vs prior quarter. Footer: 'DRAFT - pending AR sign-off'. Max 1 page.
